price_note: EXPECTED PHEV range only — MG has NOT announced pricing. ex-showroom, per media estimates (Autocar/CarDekho). Never state as confirmed; frame as 'expected'.

news.fact: MG's upcoming Hector Hawk PHEV reportedly claims up to 1,000 km of combined range from a 1.5L petrol engine plus a 20.5 kWh battery (about 125 km all-electric). A pure-EV version is also reported with a 69.2 kWh pack and ~530 km CLTC range. PRE-LAUNCH — none of this is confirmed by MG; treat every figure as a claim.
